Babilon's Tower Cake ( Dairy )
By: Danielatelaviv
Published: Wednesday, May 5, 2010 - 3:18am

Ingredients




3 eggs
2 cups flour
1/2 package baking powder
1 1/2 cups brown sugar
10 grams vanilla sugar
1 cup milk
1/2 cup oil
1/4 cup cocoa powder
1/2 cup boiled wather
Filling : 
500 grams cream cheese
400 grams nougat creme
150 grams chocolate-hazelnuts wafels, crushed in a very little pieces
100 grams tosted almonds, crushed

Preparation

1 To make a dough mix all liquid ingredients together, add the mixture of dry ingredients slowly and add boiling wather on the end. Bake it and when it's over cut the dought in 2 parts and make the cake wet with the mixture of 25o ml wather, 20 g vanilla sugar and 20 ml rum. 2 Make the filling, fill the cake inside and outside, decorate it with almonds.

About


Controverse of the story of Babilon describes the taste of this 'no words' cake : hazelnuts, almonds, nougat, cocoa, cheese.. the best quality ingrediends makes the taste so rich and sofisticated.
